bounties.title: The Raenest Global Bounty - Writing, Video & Animation Bounty
bounties.description:
About Raenest
Raenest is a global financial platform that helps individuals and businesses manage money without borders. With Raenest, users can access crypto wallets, deposit and withdraw USDT and USDC through supported networks, manage SOL, BTC, and ETH, save eligible stablecoin balances in Vaults to earn up to 7% APY, and spend using virtual and physical cards.
Our mission is to make managing money across borders easier by giving individuals and businesses access to practical financial tools for their everyday needs.
This bounty invites writers, video creators, and animators to create clear, insightful, and engaging content that shows how Raenest’s crypto and stablecoin features work in practice and how people can use them to manage, save, and spend digital assets.
We want creators to showcase real-world use cases, educate new audiences and drive adoption of Raenest across global markets, particularly Nigeria, Brazil, Argentina, and the Philippines.
Tracks
You can participate in only one of the following tracks:
Track A - Written Content
-
Sign up on Raenest using code: community
-
One long-form article on Medium or Substack.
-
One distribution post on X
-
One distribution post on LinkedIn (optional but recommended).
Track B - Video
-
Sign up on Raenest using code: community
-
One original video demonstrating Raenest’s crypto and stablecoin features.
-
Publish on X, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.
Track C - Animation
-
Sign up on Raenest using code: community
-
One animated explainer video showcasing Raenest’s crypto and stablecoin features and their real-world applications.
-
Publish on X, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.
Core Content Focus (Applies to All Tracks)
Regardless of the track, your content should:
-
Use the Hashtags #StablecoinsonRaenest and #RaenestBounty
-
Clearly explain what Raenest is and why it exists as a global financial platform for individuals and businesses.
-
Showcase how users can deposit and withdraw USDT and USDC through supported networks.
-
Demonstrate how users can deposit SOL into their Raenest crypto wallets.
-
Explain how users can deposit USDT or USDC into Raenest Vaults and earn up to 7% APY on eligible stablecoin balances.
-
Showcase how users can spend using Raenest virtual and physical cards from available wallet balances, where supported.
-
Encourage audiences to sign up for Raenest, explore its crypto and stablecoin features, and make their first transaction.
-
Include your unique Raenest tag/referral code or link in your content, with a clear CTA encouraging viewers to sign up through your referral link.
Creators are encouraged to demonstrate multiple product use cases rather than simply list features. Content should show how Raenest can be useful in everyday financial activities and make it easy for viewers to understand why they should try the platform.
The number of relevant product use cases demonstrated, content quality and verified referrals will contribute to the strength of your submission.
Important: The up to 7% APY applies to eligible USDT and USDC Vault deposits, not BTC, ETH or SOL.
Narrative style (for all content):
-
Clear, practical and story-driven.
-
Prefer day-in-the-life stories of freelancers, remote workers, traders, crypto users, businesses or individuals managing money across borders.
-
Show real product experiences and practical scenarios rather than generic promotional messages.
-
Use simple language that makes crypto and stablecoin features easy to understand.
-
Include a compelling CTA and your unique Raenest referral link or code.
-
100% original, accurate and easy to understand.
Track A - Written Content: Submission Requirements
Deliverables:
-
1 long-form article (Medium, Substack or Reddit).
-
1 distribution post on X thread that summarises and distributes your article.
-
(LinkedIn post is optional but recommended)
Requirements:
-
Sign up on Raenest using code: community
-
Explain Raenest’s mission, crypto and stablecoin features, supported assets, Vaults, cards and practical use cases.
-
Highlight how users can deposit and withdraw USDT/USDC and deposit SOL.
-
Explain how users can save eligible USDT and USDC balances in Raenest Vaults and earn up to 7% APY.
-
Showcase how users can use Raenest cards and manage their available crypto and stablecoin balances.
-
Include a practical use case with screenshots or mockups of the Raenest app where possible.
-
Use a clear structure: strong hook, logical flow, subheadings and a clear CTA.
-
Include your unique Raenest referral code or link and encourage readers to sign up and explore the product.
How to submit:
-
Publish the article on compulsory channels - Medium/Substack and X thread. A LinkedIn post is optional but recommended. Link back to the article.
-
Submit:
-
The article link.
-
The X
-
LinkedIn link (optional but recommended).
-
Your Raenest tag.
-
Your unique Raenest referral tag or link.
-
Any supporting assets (if any).
Track B - Video: Submission Requirements
Deliverables:
-
One original video demonstrating Raenest’s crypto and stablecoin features.
-
Publish on the required channels: X, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
Requirements:
-
Sign up on Raenest using code: community
-
Clearly explain what Raenest is and how its crypto and stablecoin features work.
-
Demonstrate at least one practical use case, such as:
-
Depositing USDT or USDC into Raenest.
-
Depositing SOL into a Raenest crypto wallet.
-
Saving eligible stablecoins in Raenest Vaults to earn up to 7% APY.
-
Spending with Raenest virtual or physical cards.
-
Use product walkthroughs, app screenshots or screen recordings where possible.
-
Start with a strong hook that captures attention.
-
Ensure the video has clear visuals, good pacing and engaging storytelling.
-
Include your unique Raenest referral code or link and a clear CTA encouraging viewers to sign up and try Raenest.
How to submit:
-
Publish on compulsory channels - X, TikTok, Instagram & YouTube.
-
Submit:
-
Video link.
-
Your Raenest tag.
-
Your unique Raenest referral code or link.
-
Any supporting script or storyboard (optional but helpful).
Track C - Animation: Submission Requirements
Deliverables:
-
One animated explainer video (no strict time limit, but keep it concise and engaging).
Requirements:
-
Sign up on Raenest using code: community
-
Clearly explain:
-
What Raenest is.
-
How users can deposit and withdraw USDT and USDC.
-
How users can deposit SOL and manage supported crypto assets, including BTC and ETH.
-
How eligible USDT and USDC balances can be saved in Raenest Vaults to earn up to 7% APY.
-
How users can spend using Raenest virtual and physical cards.
-
How these features provide practical financial utility.
-
Use engaging animation, storytelling and clear visual explanations.
-
Include a strong hook in the first few seconds.
-
Maintain good pacing and clear visuals.
-
If you include sound, ensure clean audio and understandable voiceovers.
-
Include an on-screen or voiceover CTA pointing viewers to Raenest.
-
Include your unique Raenest referral code or link and encourage viewers to sign up.
How to submit:
-
Publish on the required channels: X, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
-
Submit:
-
Video links.
-
Any storyboard/script file (optional but helpful).
-
Your Raenest tag.
-
Your unique Raenest referral code or link.
Eligibility and Account Requirements
-
Use the Hashtags #StablecoinsonRaenest and #RaenestBounty
-
You must have a Raenest account. Sign up on Raenest using code: community
-
Participants should explore and use Raenest’s crypto and stablecoin features.
-
You must have a unique Raenest referral code or link and include it in your content.
-
Proof of genuine product usage (choose at least one):
-
A screenshot of your Raenest wallet, Vault or transaction activity (you may blur sensitive details).
-
A screenshot showing relevant product usage.
-
A short note in your submission explaining the Raenest features you explored and demonstrated.
You must also:
-
Tag @RaenestApp and your Superteam region in your public posts on X or LinkedIn.
-
Ensure your content is publicly accessible during the campaign review period.
-
Use your own referral link and avoid self-referrals or artificial referral activity.
Judging Criteria
Submissions across all tracks will be evaluated on:
-
Clarity and structure
-
Logical flow, clear explanations, minimal jargon, strong headlines/subtitles.
-
Depth of understanding
-
Accurate explanation of Raenest’s Stablecoin product, multi‑currency capabilities, and how Solana improves speed and cost.
-
Originality and storytelling
-
Unique angles (specific professions, markets, or countries), creative narratives, and practical scenarios.
-
Practicality and accuracy
-
Correct description of:
-
Receiving USDT/USDC via Solana into Raenest
-
1:1 USD conversion
-
Fees, supported currencies, and typical user flows
-
Referral acquisition: Number of users referred through your unique Raenest tag/code, successful onboarding and the number of referred users who complete their first qualifying transaction.
NB: Referral tracking will be a key part of judging. The more people you refer and the more of them complete onboarding and their first transaction, the stronger your chances of winning.
Track-specific considerations:
-
Written content: Strength of hook, narrative, clarity, educational value, quality of the distribution post and effectiveness of the CTA.
-
Video: Storytelling, presentation, visual quality, product demonstration, pacing and ability to communicate Raenest’s features.
-
Animation: Technical execution, motion, art direction, pacing, storytelling and how clearly the animation explains the product.
Engagement (likes, comments and shares) is a bonus signal but not the only factor. Referral volume alone does not guarantee a win.
Top 5 winners: Content quality, creativity and originality will account for 50% of the evaluation, while verified referral acquisition and product activation will account for the remaining 50%.
Additional 20 winners: Selected randomly from eligible participants.
Prizes
Total Prize Pool: $13,000 USDC
-
1st- $1,500
-
2nd- $1,400
-
3rd- $1,300
-
4th- $1,200
-
5th- $1,000
-
20 Additional Eligible Participants: $330 USDC each.
The top five creators will share $6,400 USDC based on the quality and performance of their submissions.
Twenty additional eligible participants will each receive $330 USDC through random selection.
Prizes are subject to verification of submissions, eligibility and qualifying activity.
Resources
-
Sign up on the Raenest App
-
Join the Raenest Community
-
Read the Raenest Brand Guide
-
SOL, BTC and ETH Explainer
-
USDT/USDC 7% APY Explainer
-
Follow us on X (Twitter)
Additional brand assets, product information, screenshots and approved campaign guidelines will be provided where necessary.
Terms
-
Participation is voluntary.
-
By submitting, participants agree that Raenest and ecosystem partners may review, lightly edit (for grammar/clarity), share, or repurpose their content across websites, social channels, newsletters, paid ads, and in‑app surfaces.
-
Participants retain authorship but grant Raenest a non‑exclusive right to use the content with appropriate attribution.

bounties.title: Make a video about our x402 Feature
bounties.description:
Pitch an x402 Use Case with Swap.io
About Swap.io
Swap.io is a swap platform on Solana. Its Agent API lets AI agents get swap quotes and build swap transactions, paying per call in USDC through x402. There’s no API key and no subscription, and each call costs a fraction of a cent.
The Task
Make a 60 to 120 second video pitching one specific way an AI agent could use x402 with Swap.io.
Show us the idea, how it works and why it matters. You don’t need to write code: mockups, slides, storyboards, diagrams or screen recordings are all welcome.
Your video should:
-
Pitch one concrete scenario. “AI agents can trade through x402” is too broad. “A Telegram bot that charges users per swap and pays Swap.io per quote” is the level we want.
-
Explain the x402 flow simply: the agent makes a request, gets a 402 (payment required), pays in USDC, and gets the answer.
-
Say why x402 beats the alternatives (API keys, subscriptions) for your use case.
Need inspiration? A trading agent that pays per quote before every trade, a rebalancer that only pays when it actually trades, a research agent that buys data per request, a Telegram bot that rebalances your portfolio.
Bonus: Make It Work (up to +30%)
Show your idea actually running: a real paid call to the Swap.io Agent API, with the transaction link on Solscan. Partial credit for a demo that runs part of the flow.
No idea where to start? The x402 setup guides walk you through your first paid call.
Requirements
-
One video per participant only. More than one submission per participant will lead to disqualification.
-
Length: 60 to 120 seconds
-
Post the video on X tagging @swapdotio and @Superteam
-
Post the video on Medium (you can copy paste your X submission) and link to swap.io
-
Original work only. AI voiceovers are fine but we prefer on camera presence; reposted or recycled content gets disqualified.
-
For the bonus: include the Solscan link in your submission
Judging Criteria
-
Idea and clarity (45%): specific, original and actually useful. Would someone who’s never heard of x402 understand it after watching
-
Production Quality (35%): editing, pacing, visuals and audio
-
Reach (20%): engagement on your X post
-
Bonus (+30%): a working demo
Rewards
-
🥇 1st: $200
-
🥈 2nd: $125
-
🥉 3rd: $80
-
4th: $60
-
5th: $35
-
6th-10th - 40k XP for Season Zero
Submission
Submit the link to your X post and the other platform. If you’re going for the bonus, add the Solscan link of your paid call.
Resources
-
Swap.io Agent API: https://hermes.swap.io
-
x402 protocol: https://x402.org
-
Swap.io: https://swap.io
-
https://discord.gg/6gQ7D4Nte
-
https://t.me/swap_io
-

bounties.title: Create an Engaging X Thread Introducing Anna AI Messenger
bounties.description:
About Anna
AI is getting super powerful, but using it can be way too complicated. People constantly switch between chatbots, coding assistants, and other tools just to get stuff done. We're changing that with Anna.
Anna is an AI-native messenger where humans and AI colleagues work together. Instead of you juggling agents or models, you just tell Anna what you want to achieve. She then organizes the right AI colleagues, coordinates their work, and brings you in when decisions or approvals are needed. Think of it like this: humans manage Anna, and Anna manages the AI. We're being built by Causis Research, an independent AI lab that's exploring new architectures and continuous learning.
Anna is currently in private preview with selected testers. If you're interested, you can join the waitlist at https://annaos.ai/.
Mandatory Participation Requirements
To qualify for this bounty and be eligible for prizes, you must complete ALL of the following:
-
Follow Anna on X: https://x.com/annaos_ai
-
Follow Invariant on X: https://x.com/notinvariant
-
Follow Causis Research on X: https://x.com/causisresearch
-
Publish an original X thread of minimum 3 posts introducing Anna, following the creative guidelines below.
-
Submit your thread URL through Superteam Earn before the deadline.
Following all three accounts is a mandatory participation requirement, not an optional recommendation.
For submission, please provide:
-
Your X username, so we can verify your submission.
-
A direct link to your publicly accessible X thread.
-
Confirmation that you follow all three official X accounts.
-
A short description of your creative approach.
-
Any original visual assets created.
Mission
Create an engaging and original X (Twitter) thread to introduce Anna to a new audience, explaining what it is, why it's being built, and how it could change working with AI.
Scope Detail
-
Create a public X thread consisting of minimum 3 posts.
-
Your thread should clearly explain:
-
The problem: Current AI tools are powerful but fragmented and complex to use effectively.
-
What Anna is: A messenger where humans and AI colleagues collaborate in the same conversations.
-
How it works: Users describe their needs, and Anna organizes and coordinates relevant AI colleagues and tools.
-
What makes Anna different: A single conversational environment for both human collaboration and AI execution, removing the need for manual agent system management.
-
The team: Anna is developed by Causis Research, an independent AI research lab.
-
Current status: Anna is in private preview and preparing for broader public access.
-
Call to action: Encourage readers to join the waitlist at https://annaos.ai/.
-
You can include your own observations, analysis, and comparisons with existing AI products, provided the information is accurate.
-
Creative Guidelines:
-
Write in English.
-
Craft a compelling opening post to draw readers in.
-
Use natural, engaging language that non-technical people can understand.
-
Include at least one original visual, diagram, or thoughtfully designed graphic.
-
Ensure all information is accurate and from official sources.
-
Tag @annaos_ai where relevant.
-
Keep the content original; avoid generic or AI-generated threads.
-
Do not claim to have personally used Anna unless you have access, and do not present preview functionality or future plans as publicly available features.
Submission Requirements
-
A direct link to your publicly accessible X thread.
-
A short description outlining your creative approach.
-
Any original visual assets you created (if applicable).
-
If your thread is a promotional entry for this competition, clearly disclose this relationship and use X's Paid Partnership disclosure.
-
Only one submission per participant will be evaluated.
Judging Criteria
-
Accuracy and understanding of Anna: 30%
-
Originality and creativity: 25%
-
Clarity and storytelling: 20%
-
Visual presentation: 15%
-
Quality of the opening hook: 10%
-
Submissions will not be judged on follower counts, likes, reposts, or other social engagement metrics.
-
Strongest submissions will clearly communicate Anna's vision without exaggerating its current capabilities.
Resources
-
Product and waitlist: https://annaos.ai/
-
Anna on X: https://x.com/annaos_ai
-
Invariant — founder/research perspective: https://x.com/notinvariant
-
Causis Research: https://causisresearch.com/
Reward Structure
-
1st Place: 150 USDC
-
2nd Place: 75 USDC
-
3rd Place: 25 USDC

bounties.title: MultiHopper Build & Route Challenge | Up to $50,000 + Revenue Share
bounties.description:
Build something that moves money.
Build a useful Solana product with MultiHopper, bring it real users, and turn onchain activity into a business. Earn ongoing integration revenue and compete for a total prize pool that grows from $5,000 to $50,000.
There is $5,000 guaranteed for the winners with more based on transaction volume success.
Why transaction volume as a goal? Because we want to help people create a business and give them a head start with MultiHopper rather than build solutions that go nowhere. And then we want to support them in growing.
That means building a product, marketing it, and growing something that you get to keep, which makes money while you sleep.
Explore the campaign and interactive earnings calculator →
Your product. Your volume. Your upside.
Customers pay a 0.5% percentage fee on full-rate transfers. Half goes to you: 0.25% of full-fee volume, or $2,500 for every $1 million routed. MultiHopper uses its own 0.25% share to fund the competition pool. Per-hop fees are excluded.
Integration revenue is separate from the prize and does not depend on winning. Partner onboarding and agreed revenue-sharing terms apply.
A prize pool that grows with adoption
-
NOTE: If your product does not generate at least $100,000 of transaction volume, you will not qualify.
-
ONLY PRODUCTION VOLUME IS COUNTED. Devnet volume does not.
-
Every additional $400,000 unlocks another $1,000.
-
$4 million funds $10,000; $8 million funds $20,000.
-
$11 million funds a $27,000 pool from $27,500 retained fees.
-
$20 million aggregated across every project that enters unlocks the maximum $50,000 pool.
These are cumulative prize pools, awarded once after verification. The top three eligible products share the funded pool in proportion to their qualifying transaction volume.
Your prize = total funded pool × your qualifying volume ÷ combined qualifying volume of the top three. For example, 40% of the winners’ volume earns 40% of the pool, in addition to integration revenue. This is a competition top-up, not a guaranteed personal 1:1 match.
Draft terms: the initial $5,000 award is conditional on reaching $2 million aggregate qualifying volume. Dates and Earn’s support for variable, volume-proportional awards must be confirmed before publication. Any fixed prize fields in this draft are placeholders; the proportional formula above is the intended allocation.
What could you build?
-
Privacy-first token sends: a wallet, bot or SDK for discreet SOL and supported-token transfers with configurable routing and timing.
-
Launch distribution and unbundling: allocation management, routed Multi-Send payouts and recipient tools for launches.
-
Migration tools: distribute replacement tokens with reconciliation, status tracking and safe retries.
-
Swaps with hooks: combine an external Solana swap integration with MultiHopper routes and signed completion webhooks.
-
AI agent treasuries: budgets, approval rules, service payments and programmable capital movement.
-
Stablecoin payments: supplier payments, invoices, checkout, payroll and marketplace payouts.
-
OTC settlement: quote-to-delivery tools with routed settlement and receipts.
-
Treasury automation: operational wallet funding, distribution schedules and event-driven workflows.
-
Agent-to-agent commerce: paid research, compute and task marketplaces.
-
Creator payouts: royalties, affiliate earnings and contributor distributions.
And of course: you could launch a token for your project with any number of launchpads to help speed your process, engineering, adoption and transaction volume.
Use the standard API, supported programmable route parameters or Multi-Send as your product needs. You can use random or custom routing APIs, as well as agentic.
Your application supplies swaps, approval policies and business logic. Build against current Solana deployment capabilities. Routing reduces simple linkage; it does not erase public-chain history or guarantee anonymity. Funds are not pooled or commingled.
Build with a recognized team
MultiHopper won third place in the Visa track at Superteam Germany’s Solana Colosseum event in Berlin.
MultiHopper is an official TRM Labs partner, with compliance controls built into the smart contract and TRM-powered screening integrated into the routing workflow. Every product you build with us will have TRM Labs compliance and screening built directly into your product by default at the smart contract level. That’s something you and your clients can rely on.
Watch Alex pitch MultiHopper
Co-founder and CBO Alex Kujavsky shares the vision and demonstrates Custom Routing.
Watch the full pitch and demo →
Our team: João (JRA), COO and co-founder, is a member of Superteam Germany. Alex Kujavsky, CBO and co-founder, is a member of Superteam Canada.
Mentorship and introductions
Winning teams are eligible for mentorship from Enigma, founder of MultiHopper and GP of EnigmaFund. He has mentored more than 40 teams, with experience across L1 ecosystems and projects including Movement, Toshi, Anyone Protocol and Perle.
-
Product, positioning and business-model guidance.
-
Fundraising strategy and investor readiness.
-
Relevant introductions within our fundraising network.
-
Connections to founders, partners and potential customers.
Support is tailored to each winning team. Introductions depend on fit and availability; funding is not guaranteed. Referenced projects describe Enigma’s experience, not campaign sponsorship.
Eligibility and judging
-
Ship a working Solana product integrating MultiHopper and complete production onboarding.
-
Generate at least $100,000 qualifying volume per product during the common measurement window with the product that has MultiHopper in it. You must generate the qualifying volume with the MultiHopper integrated product, not another one in your stack.
-
DO NOT SUBMIT A PROJECT UNTIL YOU HAVE INTEGRATED MULTIHOPPER.
-
Pass functionality, security and genuine-usage review.
-
Rank by verified, fee-adjusted transaction volume. Product quality and repeat usage break ties.
Qualifying volume is collected MultiHopper percentage fees divided by 0.0025. Discounted transfers count proportionally. Count principal once: hops and Multi-Send recipients never multiply volume.
